verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Kino as a desktop app that exposes an MCP server and that cloud agents can install and drive 'while you're away'. That is agent-driven operation of the GUI app, not a documented headless mode, CLI, or CI integration. The MCP server and agent installs are adjacent capabilities, so they earn no credit toward running the product headlessly or in CI pipelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
